review.posthog_relevance: Push notification registration API response handling
review.reason: Adds documentation and response body fields (`reason`, `detail`) to distinguish a failed push registration from a successful one while maintaining a 200 status code. This prevents SDKs from unnecessarily retrying on every app open. The change is localized to the registration response behavior.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the presence of bounded, substantive changes.
